summary: WebDAV is operational at http://node1:8080/documents/. The supplied editor account has authenticated CRUD access, anonymous access is denied, exclusive locks are enforced, and all behavior persisted through node1’s reboot.
actions_performed: Installed the RHEL-supported Apache 2.4 package without changing the OS release or kernel.
Served the supplied documents directly from /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents.
Configured persistent authentication, WebDAV locking, SELinux labels, firewalld access, and service startup.
Verified editor create, read, replace, and delete operations.
Verified tokenless updates to exclusively locked documents return HTTP 423 while token-bearing updates succeed.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its changed boot identity and full recovery.
Removed all test documents; only the original brief.txt and budget.csv remain.

evidence.summary: Apache listens on TCP 8080, authenticated PROPFIND returns 207, and OPTIONS advertises DAV classes 1 and 2.

evidence.requirement: Editor can create, read, replace, and delete documents
evidence.summary: Observed HTTP 201 create, 200 read, 204 replace, verified replacement content, 204 delete, and 404 afterward.

evidence.requirement: Anonymous clients cannot access the workspace
evidence.summary: Anonymous requests returned HTTP 401 before and after restart while authenticated requests succeeded.

evidence.requirement: Exclusive locks prevent updates without the lock token
evidence.summary: Exclusive LOCK succeeded; tokenless overwrite returned HTTP 423 and preserved content, while token-bearing overwrite succeeded. This was reconfirmed after restart.
Initial and final SHA-256 hashes match. Final workspace contains only brief.txt and budget.csv at their original sizes.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged

evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline and boot ID, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, proved the boot ID changed, and verified recovered service, listener, firewall, SELinux, authentication, documents, and lock enforcement.
